calculation.description: Contrarian one-day return, normalized by each instrument's trailing 10-session realized return volatility; higher values indicate stronger reversal opportunity.

validation.universe: 15 tradable benchmark instruments; daily cross-sectional Spearman IC; minimum 8 valid instruments per date
validation.regime_notes: Positive daily IC in all three evaluated regimes, with gradual attenuation in 2025-2027. IC and ICIR exceed benchmark gates of absolute IC 0.0070 and absolute ICIR 0.0840.
